question: How many countries will participate in ICC 2023 ODI Cricket World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is **10**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **10 countries** will participate in the ICC 2023 ODI Cricket World Cup.
 
• The tournament will be held in **India**.
 
• The format will be a round-robin followed by **knockout stages**.
 
• The top **8 teams** from the ICC ODI rankings automatically qualify, with the remaining 2 spots decided by a qualifying tournament.
 
• This is the **13th edition** of the Cricket World Cup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The **ICC Cricket World Cup** is an international cricket competition established in 1975. It is organized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**, the global governing body for cricket. The tournament is held every four years and is one of the most viewed sporting events worldwide. It features **One Day International (ODI)** matches, where each team faces a set number of overs, typically 50.
